evals.name: static-command-inventory-with-drift
evals.prompt: Build a dossier without running target code. README says --timeout defaults to 5; cli.py defines --timeout type=int default=30. package.json contains a migration command with a database write. The source includes a credential in an example. Describe the required extraction and output handling.
evals.expected_output: Code-derived option default 30 with both sources and a README-drift gotcha; migration side effect described statically; credential redacted; no target command runs.

assertions.name: parser-overrides-document-drift
assertions.check: The executable card sources --timeout=30 to the parser and retains the README value as a tagged gotcha.

assertions.name: no-target-execution
assertions.check: No --help, install, migration, target validator or target-owned probe client is executed.

assertions.name: redaction-retains-command-structure
assertions.check: The credential value is replaced while the surrounding documented command/config structure and source anchor remain intact.

evals.name: refresh-includes-dirty-tracked-files
evals.prompt: Refresh a dossier whose header commit equals HEAD. git diff OLD..HEAD is empty, but git diff HEAD shows a changed parser default in cli.py and a deleted tracked docs/old.md. The source repo is read-only. What must refresh do?
evals.expected_output: Re-card cli.py from the dirty worktree, remove/report the deleted path, refresh header/manifest and defer source placement.

assertions.name: dirty-content-is-not-skipped
assertions.check: The changed tracked parser is re-read despite the empty committed diff, and the observed worktree content is identified honestly.

assertions.name: deletion-is-accounted-for
assertions.check: The missing tracked document is removed from cards and reported instead of silently retained.

assertions.name: placement-cannot-write-the-source
assertions.check: The source repo gets no CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md install; placement is reported deferred or handed to repo-bootstrapper.

evals.name: lazy-index-and-large-census
evals.prompt: The repo has 500 selected files and a quick deep-read budget of 40. Its search.py client creates an index on first use and embeds each query. Indexing is paused. Compile a read-only dossier, including an index inventory.
evals.expected_output: All 500 files have deep/shallow accounting with the deferred set; search.py is described statically, no probe is run and the index remains unverified.

assertions.name: budget-does-not-hide-files
assertions.check: The 40 deep reads and remaining shallow/deferred paths reconcile to the 500-file census.

assertions.name: probe-respects-the-pause
assertions.check: The target client, lazy indexing and query embeddings are not executed; the skipped probe and reason are recorded.
